pages.title: Ada Lovelace
pages.purpose: 展示 Ada Lovelace 姓名、简短介绍及两件作品。使用 ProfileCard 组件渲染个人资料与作品列表。

components.name: ProfileCard
components.purpose: 接收 name、bio 与 works 属性并渲染个人资料卡与作品列表，用于首页静态展示。

files.purpose: 首页页面，定义静态的姓名、简介与两件作品数据，并引入 ProfileCard 展示。
展示型组件，props 接 name、bio、works，输出个人资料卡与作品项。

acceptance.action: 打开首页 / 并等待渲染完成。
acceptance.expected: 页面可见标题“Ada Lovelace”及简短介绍文字。

acceptance.action: 查看首页作品列表区域。
acceptance.expected: 列表恰好包含两项且名称分别为 Analytical Engine 和 Note G。
页面无外部图片或网络请求，作品数据来自本地静态内容。

arguments.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import ProfileCard from '../components/ProfileCard.vue';

interface Work {
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

const name = 'Ada Lovelace';
const bio = 'English mathematician and writer, chiefly known for her work on Charles Babbage\'s proposed mechanical general-purpose computer, the Analytical Engine.';
const works: Work[] = [
  {
    title: 'Analytical Engine',
    description: 'A proposed mechanical general-purpose computer designed by Charles Babbage, for which Ada wrote the first algorithm.',
  },
  {
    title: 'Note G',
    description: 'The final note in Ada Lovelace\'s translation of Menabrea\'s paper, containing an algorithm for computing Bernoulli numbers.',
  },
];
</script>

<template>
  <main class="home-page">
    <ProfileCard :name="name" :bio="bio" :works="works" />
  </main>
</template>

<style scoped>
.home-page {
  padding: 2rem 1rem;
}
</style>
